summary.tldr: Adds First Nation laws to the RCMP’s peace officer duties, including preventing offences and carrying out warrants.
what_it_does: Defines “First Nation law” in the RCMP Act as a bylaw under the Indian Act, a law under the Framework Agreement on First Nation Land Management Act, or a law made under a self-government agreement.
Requires RCMP peace officers to help prevent offences against First Nation laws, in the same way they do for federal and provincial laws.
Requires RCMP peace officers to execute warrants and perform related duties that may be carried out under First Nation laws.
who_it_affects: People subject to First Nation laws
summary.background: The bill amends the Royal Canadian Mounted Police Act. It adds a new definition of “First Nation law” and updates section 18, which lists the duties of peace officers.
